component_tree.role: bind payment selection, amount summary and final CTA

state_map.cta: disabled until selected; enabled after selection

remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: top amount strip and right-side summary both present the payable amount
remediation_actions.decision: Remove the top amount strip; the right-side summary is the only payable-amount source.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Delete the full-width amount banner and retain amount, fees and total only in the summary card.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Visual QA finds the payable amount once, inside the summary card, and no equivalent amount banner above the methods.

remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: first payment method starts above the right-side summary, creating vertical misalignment
remediation_actions.decision: Align the summary top edge with the first payment-method card and keep it sticky at 24px on desktop.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Place methods and summary in the same grid row; apply sticky top:24px to the summary column.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Before scrolling, both columns start aligned; during scroll, the summary remains visible with a 24px top offset.

remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: selected payment method is left while the primary CTA is detached inside the distant summary
remediation_actions.decision: Keep the CTA in the summary but bind its enabled state and selected-method confirmation to the current payment selection.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Disable CTA with no selection; after selection show the chosen method above CTA and enable the action.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Changing method updates the summary immediately, and no enabled CTA exists without a selected payment method.

remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: payable amount wording is repeated between the amount strip and the summary
remediation_actions.decision: Use one amount label in the summary: “Hoy pagas”; remove repeated total-payment copy elsewhere.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Keep the amount label and total only in the summary; method cards describe the method rather than restating the total.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Visual QA finds one “Hoy pagas” label and no second copy block that restates the same total.

evidence_by_criterion.layout_precision: grid, alignment and sticky offset explicit
evidence_by_criterion.visual_hierarchy: single amount source and ranking explicit
evidence_by_criterion.handoff_quality: each issue has implementation change and acceptance criteria
